comment: Level generator v2 (board 066, stage 2): the block-template catalog a region re-roll and a map expansion draw from, the expansion street plan, the start + goals rules. Read by Tools/TrainingGround/src/levelgen/v2Config.ts. Metres unless named _cm. Stage 3 (reference map -> style profile) will add a 'style' block that re-weights templates.catalog.*.weight.

templates.comment: force_change: a re-rolled block always gets another type than it had. candidates_per_lot: how many types a lot tries (seeded weighted order) before keeping its old content. inset_m: the margin a template keeps inside its lot.

classic.comment: The type each block of the classic Depot grammar (generate.ts section 3) has, by its region key. A classic-only type is not in the catalog: a re-roll replaces it by a catalog type.

expansion.comment: Canvas = the map's size x sqrt(factor) (x2 ~ 250 x 175, x4 ~ 354 x 248, x6 ~ 434 x 304 for the 177 x 124 Depot), the old map stays centred (its UE coordinates do not change). New area: a ring street round the old map, the old edge roads and the canal extended to the new edge, local streets every grid_step_m, the blocks between filled from templates.catalog.

objectives.comment: Start + 2-4 goals visited in any order. default_count by expansion factor (1 = not expanded). Distances in metres on the plan; reachability is the ground nav (evaluate.ts NavGrid).
objectives.manual_comment: Manual goals (UX round, task 072): the designer adds / drags / deletes goals on the plan; manual_count_min..count_max goals. A spot in a wall, outside the map, in the canal, in a locked building or unreachable from the start is an ERROR (red, the reason shown, the goal is not moved); closer than min_from_start_m / min_spacing_m is a WARNING.

full_reroll.comment: Region re-roll mode 'full' (UX round, task 072): inside the zone the selected blocks are cut into new parcels (lot subdivision), each parcel gets a catalog type, and the parcel the template fills is shrunk / shifted / turned (the street side) by the chaos 0..1. chaos 0 = tidy: even cuts, parcels flush with the street, the same setback; chaos 1 = irregular: uneven cuts, random setbacks and side gaps, corner parcels may face the other street. Every cut leaves both parts on a street (doors and gates face streets). Sibling parcels of one block re-roll together when all of them are in the zone.

plan_view.comment: The 2D plan's zoom + pan (UX round, task 072): zoom limits relative to the fitted view, the wheel step per notch, the +/- buttons' step.

playback.comment: The squad playback after «Прогнать отряд» (UX round, task 072): the simulator's frames sampled at sample_hz, the speeds offered, the leader's trail length.

rotation.comment: Rotated buildings (designer 2026-11-16, item 4): «Макс. угол поворота зданий». max_deg_default 0 = every building axis-aligned (the industrial look, all current maps); > 0 = each block template (its buildings, fences, covers, ladders, the route's visit into it) stands rotated by a seeded angle within +-max about the template's centre, shrunk to fit its lot (a template whose rotated fit is below its minimum size stays square). In the full re-roll the angle is also scaled by the chaos (chaos 0 = square). max_deg_limit = the UI's upper bound. min_deg: smaller drawn angles are rounded to 0.

sim_nav.comment: The squad simulator's walkability («Прогнать отряд», evaluate.ts; bug 2026-11-16 evening): the ground walls PLUS every cover at least cover_min_height_cm tall (a cover is its four edges + a spine along its long side, so its whole rectangle is solid - the UE navmesh is carved by them the same way). A route point that falls inside an obstacle is moved to the nearest walkable spot within snap_max_m before the walk.

build.comment: «Собрать в Unreal» (UX round, task 072): the target map is /Game/Maps/Generated/L_Gen_<Name>, Name = the accepted layout name without the prefix strip_prefix (regex), each '_' word capitalised (gen_ref_01_02_depot_1_x4 -> L_Gen_Depot_1_X4). poll_s = the page's status poll.
build.log_comment: The scripts run hidden (no window); their output goes to the page's log panel: the server keeps the last log_lines lines (also Saved/LevelGen/<build|route>_<map>.log), the status poll sends the last log_tail.

pmc_posts.comment: PMC posts + their charges (docs/design/PMC_DEFENCE.md D2, designer 2026-11-18 evening; task 087): the generator places 1-N PMC squads at strategic places of the tactical map (pmcPosts.ts) and the defend squads' mines / tripwires round them. count_by_factor: [min, max] posts by the expansion factor (1 = not expanded), drawn seeded. kinds: the draw weight and the squad size per post kind (ambush_exit = a hiding spot at a chokepoint, overwatch_roof = a roof spot, window = a window stand point over a line, hiding_spot = a hiding spot off the chokepoints). A post never stands inside a chokepoint outline (+ chokepoint_margin_m), within min_from_start_m of the player start, within route_clear_m of the mandatory route on its own layer, or farther than max_from_route_m from it; posts keep squad_spacing_m apart, one per building. posture_weights: defend / hunt share; delay_s: the level JSON's delay per posture; weights_file: the commander weights file.

charges.comment: Charges of a DEFEND post (D2; hunt posts get none). Supply: sappers_per_squad x per_sapper (designer Q1: the PMC sapper carries 2 mines + 1 tripwire). Order: doorway mine (the door of the post's building the attack enters - nearest to the attack anchor = the mandatory route point nearest the post), then mines on the straight approach line anchor -> target (the post / its door / its ladder foot) from first_mine_m out every mine_spacing_m, then on the second line target -> the mandatory-route point second_line_back_m upstream of the anchor (towards the start: the way the attackers come); the tripwire: inside roof access (stairwell top / hatch, access_offset_m onto the roof - outside the validator's 175 cm stair keep-out) for a roof post, an outside ladder / external stair -> no access trap (the guard covers it); a window post: across the building's other door; else (and when those fail) across the flank, flank_m to the side of the post / its door / ladder foot, the covered side first. Never within retreat_clear_m of the retreat line (post -> retreat_m straight away from the anchor), route_clear_m of the mandatory route, start_clear_m of the start, mine_spacing_m of another charge; every charge passes the props static validator (the game drops nothing at load).
